controls.design: same treatment message with author replaced by a fresh non-supporting validator (T2) or, for T3, the same vote at a different observed round (round-shift, invisible to the round-scoped oracle); CPU tokenizer scan preregistered; token-count equality vs the TREATMENT arm is the recorded criterion

controls.covers: 6 selected pairs (one per contrast group where available)
controls.design: as in the pilot: vote for the alternative block by a non-supporter (T2) / proposal append (T3); token counts recorded vs treatment under the corrected criterion

append a duplicate of an existing candidate vote (same author, block, round; received = max existing); gold provably invariant (same author cannot create equivocation with itself); probes sensitivity to vote multiplicity

the treatment message with received shifted to another unused in-window value (deterministic: nearest unused below the treatment value; fallback nearest above); gold invariant These are TREATMENT-FORMAT controls: built on the treatment state, their gold equals the treatment gold (reject_conflict); the contrast is prediction change under timestamp/order-only variation of the same conflict edit.
controls.purpose: gold-invariant SHAM: timestamp digits/position of the appended vote

controls.design: reverse the received_messages list of the treatment state; set of messages identical; gold invariant by oracle construction These are TREATMENT-FORMAT controls: built on the treatment state, their gold equals the treatment gold (reject_conflict); the contrast is prediction change under timestamp/order-only variation of the same conflict edit.

data: Pinned DEV corpus only (SHA 2920e1c9...); Twins family only for pair axes (LANL has no unseen groups: its 3 day groups were all consumed by A428 - recorded as an external-validity boundary)

execution.independent_review: fresh second-path verifier (no import of the primary implementation)

falsifiable_hypothesis: On UNSEEN run groups, appending one valid equivocation vote produces conflicting_vote-head recognition failures materially above token-matched neutral and pre-existing-conflict (T3) contrasts; certificate_action follows the model's own C/Q values.

hard_resource_bounds.authorization: User standing authorization 2026-10-25 ('给你授权，...继续工作直到产出可支撑论文的完整成果') recorded in the G3 admission receipt with this frozen budget; per-round cap 128 never exceeded
hard_resource_bounds.model_loads_construction: 1 CPU checkpoint load for tokenizer/render (A428 G0B precedent)

interpretation_boundaries: Source-local policy consistency on simulator scenes; no deployment, attacker-reachability, or mechanism claim; white-box patching remains a separately gated future stage per the paper-readiness review.

pair_families.baseline: C=0, support < quorum (gold wait), support >= 1, observed alternative block, max(received) <= decision_time
pair_families.edit: append valid vote for a different observed block by an existing supporter (deterministic: lowest-index supporter, lowest block id, received = max(existing received)); gold wait -> reject_conflict
pair_families.selection: one pair per run group; groups drawn round-robin from unseen groups sorted by group id

pair_families.baseline: C=0, support >= quorum (gold accept), observed alternative block, append feasible
pair_families.edit: same edit rule; gold accept -> reject_conflict
pair_families.note: these are the two pilot cells (run-100/125) that lacked any executed neutral; the scaled cell is the paper's key missing control

pair_families.edit: append valid candidate vote from a fresh validator (gold stays reject_conflict)
pair_families.selection: prefer run groups that also carry a T2 pair (within-group appended-vs-preexisting contrast); one pair per group

paper_integration: Results replace the pilot's conflict-axis section: pilot 6/6 becomes the discovery observation, G3 provides the unseen-group replication or its refutation; manuscript to be committed to the repository for auditability.
primary_endpoints: conflicting_vote head correctness on T2 new arms (recognition; the reclassified primary)
certificate_action correctness on T2 new arms per recomputed gold, with the action-equals-f(predC,predQ) consistency check on every row
contrast rates: T2 recognition failure vs N1B neutral violation vs T3 pre-existing recognition, per run group (cluster = group)
SHAM violation rates (SA/TS/RO) as gold-invariant format bounds
baselines: deterministic rule ceiling (oracle, 100% by construction), persist-at-old-decision baseline, majority-class per cell
reclassification_basis: Independent multihead screen 2026-10-25_A461_REAL_G1_103_multihead_conflict_recognition_root_cause_screen.json: on the pilot's six conflict-axis pairs the conflicting_vote head was wrong 6/6, evidence_level 0/6, quorum 6/6 correct, and action equalled the rule applied to the model's own C/Q 6/6; same-run T3 pairs show pre-existing conflicts ARE recognized. G2 errata ed364d1 (N1 criterion, McNemar 4-pair p=0.125, failed_to_change != sign reversal, N2 third-oracle bug).
secondary: signed head logit deltas (conflicting_vote true-minus-false; action option margins)
first-difference token indices and per-arm token counts under the corrected criterion
stop_conditions: STOP_INSUFFICIENT_UNSEEN_GROUPS: fewer than 6 unseen groups with eligible T2 scenes in a cell (freeze what exists, report)
STOP_NEUTRAL_UNMATCHED_MAJORITY: fewer than half of T2 pairs achieving token-matched N1B (freeze and report the matched subset)
unseen_group_exclusion: Exclude every run group touched by (a) the A428 frozen 12 Twins scenes (archived source_group values) and (b) the A461-PSMI pilot pair_rows source_groups. The exclusion list is frozen in G0C/census.json at construction time.
